mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.device_id, r.device_iemi, r.device_type, r.record_timestamp, r.organization_code, r.speed, r.seeding_area, r.created_at, r.on_duty, s.robot_id, s.name, s.value, o.owner_name,o.owner_number, g.longitude, g.latitude, g.province, g.city, g.district, g.township, g.full_address, g.update_time FROM seeding_robot_general_data r LEFT JOIN seeding_robot_sensor_data s ON r.id = s.robot_id LEFT JOIN latest_geo_location_info g ON r.device_iemi = g.imei LEFT JOIN seeding_robot_user_info o ON r.device_iemi = o.device_imei WHERE r.device_iemi = #{robotIEMI} ORDER BY r.record_timestamp DESC

SELECT r.id,r.device_id, r.device_iemi, r.device_type, r.record_timestamp, r.organization_code, r.speed, r.seeding_area, r.created_at, r.on_duty, s.robot_id, s.name, s.value, o.owner_name,o.owner_number, g.longitude, g.latitude, g.province, g.city, g.district, g.township, g.full_address, g.update_time FROM ( SELECT * FROM seeding_robot_general_data WHERE device_iemi = #{robotIEMI} ORDER BY record_timestamp DESC LIMIT 1 ) r LEFT JOIN seeding_robot_sensor_data s ON r.id = s.robot_id LEFT JOIN latest_geo_location_info g ON r.device_iemi = g.imei LEFT JOIN seeding_robot_user_info o ON r.device_iemi = o.device_imei ORDER BY r.record_timestamp DESC

SELECT r.id, r.device_id,r.device_iemi, r.device_type, r.record_timestamp, r.organization_code, r.speed, r.seeding_area, r.created_at,r.on_duty, s.robot_id, s.name, s.value, o.owner_name,o.owner_number, g.longitude, g.latitude, g.province, g.city, g.district, g.township, g.full_address, g.update_time FROM ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_iemi ORDER BY record_timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM seeding_robot_general_data ) r LEFT JOIN seeding_robot_sensor_data s ON r.id = s.robot_id LEFT JOIN latest_geo_location_info g ON r.device_iemi = g.imei LEFT JOIN seeding_robot_user_info o ON r.device_iemi = o.device_imei WHERE r.rn = 1

SELECT r.id, r.device_id, r.device_iemi, r.device_type, r.record_timestamp, r.organization_code, r.speed, r.seeding_area, r.created_at, r.on_duty, s.robot_id, s.name, s.value, o.owner_name,o.owner_number, g.longitude, g.latitude, g.province, g.city, g.district, g.township, g.full_address, g.update_time FROM ( SELECT * FROM seeding_robot_general_data WHERE device_iemi = #{imei} ORDER BY record_timestamp DESC LIMIT 20 ) r LEFT JOIN seeding_robot_sensor_data s ON r.id = s.robot_id LEFT JOIN latest_geo_location_info g ON r.device_iemi = g.imei LEFT JOIN seeding_robot_user_info o ON r.device_iemi = o.device_imei ORDER BY r.record_timestamp DESC

SELECT r.id, r.device_id, r.device_iemi, r.device_type, r.record_timestamp, r.organization_code, r.speed, r.seeding_area, r.created_at, r.on_duty, s.robot_id, s.name, s.value, o.owner_name,o.owner_number, g.longitude, g.latitude, g.province, g.city, g.district, g.township, g.full_address, g.update_time FROM ( -- 第一步：先分页每个设备最新数据 SELECT * FROM ( SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device_iemi ORDER BY record_timestamp DESC) AS rn FROM seeding_robot_general_data ) AS ranked WHERE ranked.rn = 1 ORDER BY record_timestamp DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ) AS r LEFT JOIN seeding_robot_sensor_data s ON r.id = s.robot_id LEFT JOIN latest_geo_location_info g ON r.device_iemi = g.imei LEFT JOIN seeding_robot_user_info o ON r.device_iemi = o.device_imei
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT device_iemi FROM seeding_robot_general_data GROUP BY device_iemi ) t
